name: Geobukseon Retaliation

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Access Tian Xia origin

Trigger You would take damage.

---
Your armor has a retractable spike-covered shell reminiscent of Hwanggot's heavily armored geobukseon, or "turtle ships." The shell unfolds across your body, giving you a +4 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 2 to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn. Spiked chains propelled by small bursts of black powder also erupt from the shell, dealing 3d4 piercing,2 persistent,fire damage (basic Reflex save save against your class DC) to all creatures in a 5-foot emanation.
